data.name: AppsStackNotReady
data.value: This server has no web server yet, so sites cannot be created or changed. Finish the server setup by installing a web server from the app store, then try again.

data.name: AppsInUse
data.value: Sites on this server still use this app, so it was not removed. Move or delete those sites, then try again.

data.name: AppsNotInstalled
data.value: This app is not installed on the server. Install it from the app store first.

data.name: AppsAlreadyInstalled
data.value: This app is already installed, so nothing was changed.

data.name: AppsOperationInProgress
data.value: Another install or removal of this app is already running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.

data.name: AppsWebServerAlreadyInstalled
data.value: A web server for sites is already installed or being changed on this server, so nothing was installed. Remove the other one first; only one can serve sites at a time.

data.name: AppsNotInstallable
data.value: This server's package sources do not offer that app, so nothing was installed. Choose one from the list the page shows.

data.name: AppIdInvalid
data.value: That is not an app this panel can manage. Choose one from the app store.

data.name: AppsOutcomeUnobserved
data.value: The panel lost track of the install or removal before the server reported how it ended, so the result is not known. Check the app's state in the app store, then try again.

data.name: AppsOperationFailed
data.value: The install or removal stopped unexpectedly. Check the app's state in the app store, then try again, and contact support if it keeps happening.

data.name: AppsServiceActionUnknown
data.value: That is not an action the panel offers. Choose start, stop, restart or reload.

data.name: AppsHasNoService
data.value: This app has no service to control: it is a runtime that sites run on.

data.name: AppKindUnknown
data.value: That is not a kind of app. Choose a web server or a runtime.

data.name: AppStateUnknown
data.value: That is not a state an app can be in. Choose installing, installed, failed or removing.
